notes: New-game home state (task 32d). 'empty' strips the home lot of furniture and appliances (walls, doors, windows, floors, ceiling lights, the mailbox and the yard's pond/garden stay) and adds no money: you start with what the scenario gives (task 63). Free Play and every scenario can use either. 'furnished' is the old start.

options.label: Empty home (furnish it yourself)
options.desc: Bare walls and floors, and only the coins in your pocket. Buy a bed, fridge, stove and seats as you earn: press B.

options.label: Furnished home
options.desc: Move into a home that already has its furniture.

basics.text: Buy a bed so your Folk can sleep properly: press B, open Bedroom, pick a bed and click a spot in the bedroom.
Next, a toilet: press B, open Bathroom and place a Toilet in the bathroom.
Now a fridge for food: press B, open Kitchen and place a Fridge. Then add a stove.
A shower keeps everyone fresh: press B, open Bathroom and place a Shower.
A stove lets your Folk cook: press B, open Kitchen and place a Stove.
Everyone needs somewhere to sit: press B and add a chair or sofa.

done_text: That is the basics covered. Keep furnishing as your coins allow.
empty_tips: You rent this empty flat and you are on your own: nobody feeds you. You eat from your pocket (the bakery, Zip Burger, a vending machine) or you cook, and cooking costs ingredients.
Earn first: click Phone at the top, open the Jobs app and apply (a dishwasher or a proofreader can start today), or click the mailbox for Odd Jobs. Rent and bills come every week.
Click Myself (next to your face) for things you can do with no furniture, like sleeping on the floor. Buy a bed when you can: press B, Bedroom.
Space pauses. Keys 1, 2 and 3 set the speed. You choose everything your Folk does: if you do not, they stand and wait.
fallbacks_note: Autonomy fallbacks live in data/interactions.json: sleep_floor (existing), welcome_snack, cafe_restroom.
